dash.title: Pick up where you left off
dash.lead: {done} of {total} lectures watched. Short daily sessions beat one long cram.
lecture.noVideo: The video file for this lecture was not found in the course folder.
lecture.noTranscript: No transcript in this language for this lecture.
quizzes.lead: {n} questions from the course. Practice mode shows feedback after each answer; exam mode is timed and scores at the end.
quiz.noMistakes: Nothing to review yet. Questions you answer wrong in any quiz land here until you get them right.
quiz.practiceHelp: Check each answer as you go and read why every option is right or wrong.
quiz.examHelp: {min} minutes, like the real exam. Answers are revealed only after you submit.
quiz.keys: Keys: 1-6 choose · Enter check/next · ← → move · F flag
quiz.addedToMistakes: {n} missed questions were added to your review list.
cards.lead: Five-box Leitner system: a card you know moves up a box and comes back later; a card you miss goes back to box 1.
cards.boxHelp: Higher boxes come back less often: box 2 after 1 day, box 5 after 14 days.
cards.showFront: Show the front of the card
cards.question: Question
cards.tapToFlip: Click or press Space to flip
cards.keys: Keys: Space flip · 1 didn't know · 2 knew it
cards.roundHelp: {n} cards are still due, including the ones you missed. Go again while they are fresh.
cards.allDoneHelp: Every card in this filter is scheduled for later. Come back tomorrow, or study ahead.
glossary.lead: {n} exam terms pulled from the lectures, each linked to the lecture that teaches it.
glossary.none: No term matches that search. Try an AWS service name or a shorter word.
notes.lead: {n} notes the instructors added between lectures: service renames, console changes and cost warnings.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: That lecture, section or quiz does not exist in the course content.
lecture.delayReset: Subtitle delay for this lecture. Click to reset to 0.
auth.mode: Sign in or create an account
auth.loginLead: Each account keeps its own lectures, quiz scores and flashcards.
auth.registerLead: Your progress is saved on this machine, under your account.
auth.usernameHint: 3-32 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
auth.error.invalid_username: Username must be 3-32 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
auth.error.username_taken: That username is taken. Pick another or sign in.
auth.error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.error.network: Cannot reach the study server. Is npm run dev still running?
auth.error.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
summary.title: Lecture summary
summary.hint: Key points, services, fun fact and a diagram
summary.services: Services and what they are for
lecture.langAiHint: Natural Vietnamese rewritten by AI, technical terms kept and highlighted. The original VI stays available.
mistakes.title: Mistakes room
mistakes.lead: {n} questions to fix. They leave this list once you answer them correctly.
mistakes.noRelated: No clearly related lecture was found.
quizzes.clearConfirm: Delete all scores, missed questions and unfinished attempts for this account? This cannot be undone. Lectures and flashcards are kept.
plan.lead: Pick when you start and when you sit the exam. Lectures are spread over the days by video length, in course order, and the last 7 days before the exam are kept for practice exams.
plan.summary: {days} study days, about {minutes} min of video a day. Review week starts {review}.
plan.tooShort: Leave at least 8 days between the start and the exam: the last 7 are for review.
plan.late: {n} lectures from earlier days are not done yet.
plan.free: Nothing new today: catch up or rest.
backup.title: Back up progress
backup.help: Save everything you have done (lectures, scores, flashcards, study plan, settings) to a file, or load it into this account.
backup.confirm: Importing replaces all progress in this account with the file. Continue?
backup.invalid: This file is not a progress backup from this app. Nothing was changed.
comp.lead: Race the other learners on this server: study ranking, live 1v1 duels and survival runs.
comp.duelHint: Challenge someone online, answer to hit
comp.survivalHint: Answer until your lives run out
comp.loadError: Could not load the leaderboards. Check that the server is running, then reload.
comp.empty: No results yet. Play a round to open the board.
surv.title: Survival
surv.lead: Every question in the course, one level at a time. A right answer grows your streak, a wrong one costs a life.
surv.rules: {n} questions, {lives} lives, {points} points per right answer. Longer streaks pay more, up to 3x.
surv.saveError: Could not save this run to the leaderboard.
duel.title: 1v1 duel
duel.lead: Pick a move and a question each round. Answer right to land it; the faster you pick and answer, the harder it hits.
duel.error.busy: That player is already in a match.
duel.error.network: Lost contact with the server. Retrying…
duel.nobody: Nobody else is online. Ask a friend to sign in on this server (same network) and open this page.
duel.actionHint.attack: Full damage, but a defend absorbs most of it.
duel.actionHint.break: Weaker than attack, but goes straight through a defend.
duel.actionHint.defend: Absorbs up to 80% of an attack. Deals no damage.
duel.speedRule: Both start at {hp} HP. You have {choose}s to pick; power then drops the longer you take, down to 35%. A wrong or missing answer does nothing.
duel.surrenderConfirm: Surrender this duel? It counts as a loss.
duel.goHint: Your question appears as soon as you lock in.
duel.needBoth: Pick a move and a question level to fight.
duel.question: Your question
